name: Voltwing Wyvern
description: Original electric wyvern in the low-poly pixel-art genre: faceted lofted forms, chunky hand-painted pixels, gold scales with bevelled storm-indigo lightning chevrons and glowing volt seams, electric-vein membrane wings, cyan storm crystals and a lightning-blade tail. VFX: flickering crossed-card bolts, sparks, a thunder-breath beam, bloom in previews.
author: lowpix example
